configlocation.description: Path to the config directory (read-only, not editable via settings)

defaultscheme.description: Protocol scheme assumed when missing from a URL (gopher/gemini/http/https)

geminiblocks.description: How to render preformatted blocks in gemini docs (block/alt/both/neither)

maxwidth.description: Max line width for text wrapping (min enforced: 10)

savelocation.description: Directory path for file writes (must exist)

searchengine.description: Base URL template for search engine queries

telnetcommand.description: Shell command to invoke for telnet (URL appended automatically)

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for gopher/gemini

bookmarks.description: List of bookmarks; each entry is an id, url, and name (for display only). Not editable via INI syntax — simulated via comments for clarity; actual bookmarks are stored as `bm.{id} = url` lines in .bombadillo.ini. This schema reflects common usage patterns and allows realistic test data.
